people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
translations.bsb: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.
translations.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
